actuators.required_behavior: Resolve eligible AUTO_EXECUTABLE/AUTO_RATIFIABLE authority_delta=NONE work into the VIT route.
A START_SUCCESSOR decision identifies the next packet only; execution must freeze a PIP and detached qualification before permanent-candidate assurance.
ORCH may select work but cannot bind physical main or create queue precedence; output is bound to DSAI3V VIT and requires detached qualification before execution.
CREATE_BRANCH/OPEN_PR planning is dry-run only and cannot become a permanent candidate without later exact detached VIT qualification.
Assisted Git writes have no merge authority; a pushed construction ref remains non-authoritative and any permanent PR still requires exact-head detached qualification.
The repository abstraction has no merge surface; any concrete permanent-PR transport must publish exact-head detached qualification before CI eligibility.
Historical pre-activation shadow evidence is non-authoritative; any new proposal PR created after detached-qualification enforcement must satisfy the required preflight.

After the final remote branch head exists, build the exact PIP, publish its detached qualification envelope/head binding, verify the branch tree, then open/update the human-readable PR. PR text is not qualification authority.
Provide PIP-first planning for write actuators whose target bytes are known before remote branch materialisation; final permanent admission still requires exact-head detached qualification.
Freeze the exact PIP from the completed transport branch and publish a content-addressed detached qualification keyed to the exact head. Legacy PR markers are migration-only.
Store immutable content-addressed qualification envelopes and exact-head active-generation pointers on the dedicated qualification ledger ref; validate the exact head tree before admission.
Require canonical PIP and current exact-head qualification identity before general admission; physical placement remains late.
The still-active narrow pilot path requires canonical qualification and remains non-bypass.
Freeze identity-bearing packet payload before assurance; do not bind physical main.
Own only late prospective physical placement and preserve qualified payload identity across placement-only movement.
Submit only the dynamically selected current qualified candidate to the physical gateway, one writer at a time.
Wake DSAI_VIT_PHYSICAL_CONTROLLER only; no independent writer, merge authority or absolute queue position.
Fail closed unless the exact head, detached qualification, PIP and assurance generation remain identical; placement is acquired only in the final serialized lane.
Block BASE_INDEPENDENT fan-out unless the exact PR head resolves to a valid detached qualification whose PIP blob+mode identities match the checked-out head. PR text cannot substitute.

Freeze one qualification ID through READY and final acquire; any same-head qualification replacement supersedes the running generation. Final physical-main currentness remains late placement/materialisation state.
Bind external development agents to PIP-first detached qualification, prohibit PR-body qualification authority and prohibit replacement PR creation solely for placement movement.
A branch may exist as non-authoritative construction transport; physical main remains unbound during construction.
Before required CI is relied upon, the exact head must have a detached qualification envelope. The PR body is human/provenance text only and carries no PIP/authority/lineage admission authority.
Construct and qualify the packet, then park it at WAITING_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY; operator status does not exempt VIT qualification.

actuators.surface: fresh-main branch/PR reconstruction solely because physical main moved
actuators.required_behavior: Retain the qualified payload and recompute only late physical placement when it is selected for integration.

actuators.surface: recovery when VIT qualification machinery itself is unavailable or being repaired
actuators.required_behavior: Exact finite exception record only; historical PR-body lineage may be explicitly read for recovery but never grants direct SIQ bypass or forward qualification authority.

rollback: Forward-disable detached qualification for new generations and explicitly enable the historical lineage reader for bounded recovery while preserving active VIT/SIQ authority, all qualification envelopes, audit and failure evidence; never force-push or rewrite history.
